_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_sports_training.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_training_ongoing: $names$ follows the team to the training ground in her cheer outfit.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_training_result: The water break whistle blows, and the players crowd around $names$ at the rest bench.
en-us.event_erav_sports_training_01:
The outfit the team specified: a cheerleader skirt, and by regulation nothing underneath. A brisk step sends the hem flying; the eyes on the field stick to her the whole session.
Once training starts, her post is the rest bench by the sideline. When her turn to hand out water comes, a hand closes around her wrist.
"Water girl. --Knees."
en-us.event_erav_sports_training_02:
The path between the rest bench and the locker room is the daytime battleground.
Under the shade of the bench awning, she kneels on the grass and services the resting players in turn. Fifteen minutes of break time - hers is counted per head.
en-us.event_erav_sports_training_03: The size that reaches the back of her throat grows more outrageous each time. By the time evening drills end, her jaw is too sore to open.
en-us.event_erav_sports_training_04:
At the halftime whistle she is called into the locker room to "help with relaxation".
On the massage table she is taken from behind; on the next bed over, a player is still having his legs stretched by the physio, chatting about tomorrow's fixture through the curtain.
en-us.event_erav_sports_training_05:
In the closing whistle, someone pats the top of her head by way of thanks.
"Good girl. --Tomorrow, same time."
